title: solutions-pro-services-weekly-sync-notes-2026-03-31
body:
Solutions & Pro Services weekly sync notes - 2026-03-31
Attendees: Aisha (host), Marco, Priya, Evan, Lena, Tom (SRE - partial), Olivia (Customer Success - partial)
Duration: 45m

Agenda:
- Quick rundowns: active integrations (status / risks)
- Blockers & escalations
- Action items + owners + ETAs
- Capacity / Dedicated scheduling notes
- Demos / next week milestones

Notes / Per-customer status:

1) Acme Corp (Retail search ranking) - Owner: Marco
- Current phase: staging validation for reranker + embeddings migration
- Last week: migrated QA traffic to new embedding model (rf-embed-v2-quantized) - initial latency improvement observed (~12% token cost reduction).
- Today: staging tests showing occasional tail latency spikes when batch sizes hit 64 for long queries (>1024 tokens).
- Blocker: Unknown interaction with their prefix-caching; need SRE input on kernel selection for long sequence paths. Tom to investigate kernel choices and KV cache behavior (see JIRA-SE-4321).
- Next steps: Marco to schedule a deep-dive with Tom & infra on 2026-04-01. Priya to prepare a rollback plan for embedding change in case of production regressions.
- ETA: safe promo window targeted 2026-04-07 if no regressions.

2) FinBank (Financial summaries / compliance) - Owner: Priya
- Current phase: Private deployment (VPC) onboarding; KMS/HSM integration in progress.
- Last week: Compliance docs signed; infra team provisioned initial tenant in us-east-1.
- Today: HSM vendor cert exchange delayed (vendor documentation incomplete). This delays key rotation acceptance tests.
- Blocker: HSM vendor response time. Customer legal asks for customer-managed key rotation policy example.
- Actions: Priya to share a template key rotation policy by 2026-04-02. Evan to coordinate with Security for a short-run mitigation (timeboxed support for rotation steps).
- ETA: basic production-ready setup delayed ~1 week (tracking 2026-04-10).

3) HealthCo (Clinical summarization) - Owner: Evan
- Current phase: post-demo contract negotiation; pilot to start after infra hardening.
- Last week: Completed privacy-preserving logging config and HIPAA checklist items.
- Today: Customer asked for model explainability examples and a standardized eval set for clinical prompts.
- Action: Evan to deliver a 10-prompt eval set + example outputs by 2026-04-03. Solutions team to provide a short write-up on deterministic output controls and median-latency targets.
- Risk: If explainability requested increases scope (interpretability tooling), may need additional SOW. Flagged to Olivia (CS).

4) TravelCo (Search + prompts) - Owner: Lena
- Current phase: Dedicated cluster sizing + autoscale policy tuning.
- Last week: Ran throughput tests with dedicated-pool-3 (A10x8) - met P95 latency target at baseline load.
- Today: Customer requested burst capacity for holiday promo window; wants SLA for sustained 10k rps.
- Actions: Lena to produce capacity plan and cost estimate by 2026-04-02. Product to confirm burst policy options (can we guarantee 10k rps without reserved additional GPUs?).
- Blocker: Finance needs a rough monthly committed cost to include in SOW.

General blockers / cross-customer items:
- Kernel selection and long-sequence tail latency (affects Acme + TravelCo) - SRE action item (Tom) to present root-cause options.
- HSM vendor delays (affects FinBank) - Security + PS to escalate.
- Standardized eval set templates requested by multiple customers (HealthCo + a demo prospect) - Solutions team to produce a 10-25 prompt template library.

Action items (owner / due):
- Tom (SRE): Investigate kernel selection + KV caching tail latency - due 2026-04-02. [JIRA-SE-4321]
- Marco: Deep-dive with SRE for Acme embedding tail latency - schedule 2026-04-01.
- Priya: Provide KMS rotation policy template to FinBank legal - due 2026-04-02.
- Evan: Deliver HealthCo eval set + write-up on deterministic controls - due 2026-04-03.
- Lena: Capacity and pricing plan for TravelCo burst SLA - due 2026-04-02.
- Aisha: Prep rollout checklist for embedding promotions (staging -> prod) and share with team - due 2026-04-01.

Notes about scheduling & capacity:
- Dedicated capacity lead times: new reserved pools currently ~2-3 weeks provisioning for A10x configurations in us-west; call out in SOWs.
- We should add a short note in the next customer kickoffs about typical kernel/sequence tradeoffs and our quantization recommendations to prevent surprises. Action: Aisha to draft a one-pager.

Risks / asks for leadership:
- If HSM vendor SLA continues to slip, we may need legal to sign temporary exception language to keep onboarding moving. Please advise. (Priya)
- For TravelCo burst SLA, finance approval needed to propose a multi-tier commit; recommend a pre-approved spot-burst budget for enterprise customers. (Lena)

Next demo / milestones:
- Acme: staging -> small canary once SRE signoff (target 2026-04-07).
- HealthCo: internal explainability demo to product + CS on 2026-04-05.
- TravelCo: capacity plan review on 2026-04-02.

Parking lot / misc notes:
- Consider building a lightweight eval-kit repo (prompts + scoring scripts) for PS deliverables - could speed pilots and standardize QA.
- Possible internal workshop: "Quantization + kernel tradeoffs for long sequences" - proposed week of 2026-04-06.

Meeting adjourned. Next sync: 2026-04-07 10:00 PT

Quick TL;DR:
- Acme: on track but kernel/latency investigation required (Tom + Marco).
- FinBank: onboarding delayed by HSM vendor doc gap (Priya escalates).
- HealthCo: needs explainability eval set (Evan).
- TravelCo: capacity + pricing required for burst SLA (Lena + Finance).
- Cross-cutting: build eval templates + investigate kernel tail latency.
